summary: The agent planned and executed an exceptionally thorough replication in an isolated virtual environment with downloaded MUSE vectors. It achieved exact numerical reproductions for Tier 1 targets (ES/FR MWEAT, cosine 0.389 under the buggy PCA, LinearSVC/LDA classifiers, §4.4 Spearman) and the 200k-candidate word translation Original column. Crucially, it uncovered that the apparent translation gains under Shift/Hybrid in Table 2 are entirely an artifact of candidate set truncation (50k in the notebook vs 200k in the paper). It correctly reported that mitigation columns cannot be reproduced due to unreleased private base embeddings, demonstrating via diagnostic scripts that the released hybrid code patches only 0.27% of vocabulary. The stage exhibited outstanding calibration, rigor, and technical depth.
